pages.title: Inkwell & Thread — Hand-bound journals
pages.description: Hand-bound journals sewn one at a time in our Lisbon workshop. Paper that loves fountain pens.
headings: Sewn by hand, one at a time
pages.text: Sewn by hand, one at a time. Every Inkwell & Thread journal is stitched in our tiny Lisbon workshop by the two of us and a very opinionated cat. Our 120 gsm cotton paper drinks fountain-pen ink politely: no feathering, no ghosting, no drama. Covers are vegetable-tanned leather that gets better with every coffee stain. The A5 journal is €34 and the pocket journal is €22. We ship across the EU in 3 to 5 days.

pages.title: About — Inkwell & Thread
pages.text: Two bookbinders and a cat. We started binding notebooks for friends in 2019 and never stopped. We write long, slightly silly emails and we answer every one of yours.
